en.headline: Three former HSBC staff charged with bribery over account openings
en.dek: The ICAC alleges the relationship managers at a Causeway Bay branch accepted payments in 2024 to help customers referred by an insurance agent jump the queue.
body: The Independent Commission Against Corruption has charged three former HSBC relationship managers with bribery offences over the opening of bank accounts for customers referred by an insurance agent.

According to an ICAC press release, Chan Fu-kwan, 32, Mike Chan Wai-pak, 29, and Bernie Yau Kai-lung, 33, worked at the same Causeway Bay branch in 2024. Chan Fu-kwan is alleged to have accepted bribes of HK$1,000 to HK$1,200 per customer to facilitate account openings without queuing, receiving more than HK$35,000 in total. He is also said to have referred some customers to the other two and offered them HK$300 to HK$500 per referral.

Mike Chan faces an additional charge of betting with a bookmaker after allegedly placing bets totalling more than HK$120,000 via an online platform in February 2026. All three defendants were released on bail and are due to enter pleas at the Eastern Magistrates’ Courts today. HSBC said it fully cooperated with the investigation.

zh.headline: 三名前匯豐職員涉收賄協助開戶被控
zh.dek: 廉署指三人於銅鑼灣分行任職關係經理期間，在2024年收受利益協助保險代理轉介客戶免排隊開立銀行帳戶。
body: 廉政公署已落案起訴三名前匯豐銀行關係經理，指他們涉嫌收受利益，協助保險代理轉介的客戶開立銀行帳戶。
根據廉署新聞稿，32歲陳富昆、29歲陳偉柏及33歲邱啟龍於2024年在同一銅鑼灣分行任職。陳富昆被指每名客戶收取1,000至1,200元，合共收取超過3.5萬元，安排客戶免排隊辦理開戶手續；他又轉介部分客戶予另外兩人，並向他們提供每名300至500元的利益。
陳偉柏另被控一項與收受賭注者投注罪，指他於2026年2月透過網上平台投注超過12萬元。三名被告已獲准保釋，今日在東區裁判法院答辯。匯豐表示已全力配合調查。
